summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Travel Phrase Companion app. All backend APIs working correctly, frontend loads and functions properly with language selection, category filtering, search, and audio playback.
passed_tests: API endpoint /api/languages returns all 14 languages with proper structure
API endpoint /api/categories returns 8 phrase categories with correct structure
API endpoint /api/phrases returns 55 phrases for Japanese language
API endpoint /api/tts/generate generates audio base64 successfully
Frontend loads with header, hero section, and language selector
Language dropdown opens and shows all 14 languages correctly
Language selection works (tested Japanese to Korean switch)
Category buttons filter phrases correctly (tested Greetings category)
Search input filters phrases by text (tested with 'hello')
Audio buttons exist on phrase cards (English and Native)
Audio button clicks trigger TTS API calls successfully
All category button shows all 55 phrases
UI displays Korean translations correctly after language switch
